headline: Easy breeding chain: Katress
title: Easy Katress Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Want Katress on your team? Follow these three easy breeding steps. Step one: breed Vanwyrm with Woolipop to get Yakumo. Step two: breed that Yakumo with Sparkit to get Cinnamoth. Step three: breed that Cinnamoth with Incineram, and the egg hatches into Katress! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Katress: Vanwyrm + Woolipop = Yakumo, Yakumo + Sparkit = Cinnamoth, Cinnamoth + Incineram = Katress. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
